# Albert Heijn

> The Netherlands' leading online grocery retailer offering 21,000+ products, loyalty rewards, and culinary inspiration through integrated shopping and recipe platforms.

Albert Heijn (AH.nl) is a major Dutch supermarket chain providing comprehensive online grocery shopping, product discovery across multiple banners (AH, Gall&Gall, Etos), and lifestyle content through Allerhande magazine. The platform combines e-commerce functionality with customer support, loyalty programs, and meal planning tools.

## Key Topics

- Albert Heijn
- AH Bonus loyalty program
- Product catalog (21,000+ items)
- Online grocery shopping
- AH Voordeelshop
- Allerhande recipes
- Order management
- Customer service
- AH app
- Meal planner
- Seasonal promotions
- Dutch grocery brands
- Gall&Gall
- Etos
- AH Bezorgbundel

## Shopping & Products

- [Albert Heijn assortiment: keuze uit ruim 21.000 producten | AH.nl](https://www.ah.nl/producten): Main product catalog with 21,000+ items from Albert Heijn, Gall&Gall, Etos.

## Loyalty & Promotions

- [Bonus | Albert Heijn](https://www.ah.nl/bonus): AH Bonus loyalty program with deals and promotional offers on thousands of products.

## Culinary Content & Inspiration

- [Allerhande - Dagelijkse food inspiratie en verrassende recepten](https://www.ah.nl/allerhande): Allerhande food magazine with daily recipes, meal planner, and cooking inspiration.

## Customer Support

- [Klantenservice | Albert Heijn](https://www.ah.nl/klantenservice): Customer service hub for Albert Heijn with FAQ, order management, and support.
